video_prompt: One continuous vertical phone video, full frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. The woman — a white woman about 36 years old with fair skin and straight shoulder-length blonde hair, wearing a plain dusty-blue sweatshirt and grey joggers — sits alone, sitting on the edge of a bed with white linen sheets in a cozy bedroom at dusk, warm bedside lamps, a wooden headboard, a framed abstract print and a knitted throw, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same seat, same distance from the camera. Handheld-steady phone on a tripod, the camera stays still; the room around her stays still. She talks straight into the camera, serious and caring, like warning a friend, with small natural head movements; her hands stay clasped near her knees with small gestures.
